title: Quick Query improvements and a tidier workspace
summary: Quick Query checks your input as you type, and navigation, PlantUML and Home are easier to use.
notes: Quick Query validates input, enforces field constraints, and moves between cells more smoothly.
Convert DBeaver schemas into Quick Query from a new dialog.
Home shows your recent PlantUML diagrams.
Create files and folders inline in PlantUML and search tables and files from the catalog.
Report a bug or send feedback from the header.
The desktop sidebar stays visible as a compact rail.

slides.title: Quick Query improvements
slides.body: Catch mistakes before you run, and move through results faster.
bullets: Input is validated and field constraints are enforced.
Cell navigation is smoother, and rounding and Excel row messages are clearer.
Convert a DBeaver schema from the new conversion dialog.

bullets: Recent PlantUML diagrams appear on Home.
Create files and folders inline, and search tables and PlantUML files from the catalog.
Merge SQL and Compare Config work better on narrow screens.
